title: docs(qa): wave-2 checklist-accuracy close-out, slice B — six areas
body:
Part of #25807 (wave-2 accuracy, slice B)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 18.2.0 第二波五份测试记录，修正 ai、approvals、attachments-storage、i18n、platform-core、records-forms 六个领域共 35 条测试清单条目里的过时描述。只改文档，不动产品代码。
- 为什么改：这些条目的步骤、字段、错误码、界面文案或引用的测试文件已与当前代码不符（例如审批抽屉已移除、货币字段不再带 scale、动态摘要按读者语言渲染），下一轮运行会被误导或误判。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 QA 清单文本。三条断言随产品已变的行为改写（i18n.surface-matrix 的 a7/a10、records-forms.field-type-constraints 的 a2），旧版本的判定不再沿用。每条 revision +1、追加一行 history，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`areas/records-forms.json` 的 field-type-constraints（scale 从“已知缺口”改为“拒收、不舍入”）；`areas/i18n.json` 的 surface-matrix（a10 改为读者语言，#26167）；`areas/approvals.json` 的 quorum-m-of-n（抽屉改为请求记录页）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK`、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The slice-B close-out of the wave-2 checklist-accuracy findings that RUNNER.md routes to the wave anchor ("close out through the wave's anchor card … not extracted"). Sources: anchor comments 6433587719, 6433708086, 6433784748, 6433878766, 6433966437 and the run records #26450, #26456, #26468, #26476, #26481. Every finding was read against the code at base `fd246c22` before its edit; each item's new history row names the files read.

- **35 items** in `ai` (5), `approvals` (7), `attachments-storage` (8), `i18n` (2), `platform-core` (9) and `records-forms` (4): `revision` +1 from main's value and one appended `history` row each, citing the run record that found it (`ref` is the anchor #25807, as slice A's rows are). No existing history row is changed; the previous last row only gains the comma the appended row needs.
- **Three clauses change meaning with the product**, and say so in their history rows (a verdict for an older revision does not carry): `i18n.surface-matrix` acceptance[7] (the served document is fifteen groups, not twelve) and acceptance[10] (activity summaries render in the reader's locale since #26167, not the write locale); `records-forms.field-type-constraints` acceptance[2] (scale is enforced by rejection, `max_scale`, and currency carries no scale; it was recorded as an unenforced gap).
- `attachments-storage.upload-limits-scope-and-ownership` acceptance[3] now scores pass from a pin the ref did not name (`storage-upload-door-ownership.wall.test.ts`, HTTP over a booted wall); `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` knownGaps[0] is closed for its pin half by `storage-upload-organization-change.wall.test.ts`.
- No pin upgrades of the `Parked-on: #25807` partials. No `studio-authoring`, `access-security`, slice-A area file or `RUNNER.md` is touched.

### No change, because …

- `ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts`, `approvals.email-action-token-door`, `attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls`, `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit`, `attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap`: the run's line is "ref accurate" (a confirmation); re-read, still true.
- `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure`: a confirmation that revision 3 already names both files; both exist.
- `approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility`: ref accurate; the extra service-unit comment cases corroborate acceptance[1] below its layer only.
- `approvals.decision-action-matrix` A1: an observation (a skipped exec_review step is logged); the run says the discriminator holds.
- `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[0] "the runner builds the console itself": that is the clause's design.
- `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` "administrators are identified by sys_member role": the item identifies them by their grants, as `approval-service.ts` organizationAdministrators does; the membership role is only the grant's provisioning source.
- `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` recipe line (`media_qa_media`): already closed by revision 6 (#26876, `qamedia_media`). The item's other three lines are edited above.
- `records-forms.action-location-matrix` ("authoring refuses a throwing visible"): already in knownGaps[2] since revision 16 (#26625), which cites #26456.
- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` (`qa_nofeeds` → 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX): already renamed `qafeeds_nofeeds` (revision 11).
- `records-forms.field-group-visible-when` namespace line: steps[1] already declares namespace `qagroup` and names `qagroup_group_gate`. Its other line is edited above.
- `platform-core.boot-health` "no default-level line names the Console mount path": no clause reads a mount line; acceptance[5] reads `GET /_console/`.
- `ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport` "missing clause: AS metadata issuer equals authorization_servers[0]": that is the open product defect #26472; its fix owns the clause.
- The other items the sources name in these areas (`approvals.per-group-signoff`, `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears`, `i18n.flow-copy-translation-and-host-override`, `platform-core` console-login, nav-surfaces-render, metadata-registry-serving, metadata-authoring-roundtrip, interrupted-migration-boot-report, activation-ledger-registration-home, activation-ledger-row-contract, url-overlay-contract, lifecycle-retention-sweep, settings-audit-secret-fingerprint, protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay, settings-organization-isolation-and-platform-rung, serve-composition-v18, and the remaining `records-forms` items of #26450): named only with clause verdicts or parked partial coverage, no accuracy line. #26481 re-checked every wave-1 line on its P0 items and found them fixed.
- **Gaps, not edited (need a pin or a run, not text):** `approvals.decision-only-via-service` has no pin and #26468 carried it NOT-RUN; `records-forms.record-edit-undo` is carried BLOCKED (no packaged undoable update action on the showcase).

## Tests

No product code changed, so no package test is owed. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0 at the head (`check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`). The edits were applied by a script that rebuilds each file from base text and asserts, per area, that only the 35 items differ, each at base revision + 1 with exactly one appended history row and every earlier row equal.

## Acceptance notes

- `approvals`: four items not named by any wave-2 source still describe the retired request drawer (viewer-gating-submitter-side, notification-deep-link, dynamic-approver-routing, inbox-keyboard-flow). Rewriting them is not mechanical (inbox-keyboard-flow's drawer walk may describe removed behaviour), so they are reported for the anchor, not edited here.
- `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` steps[6] / acceptance[5] still describe `queue` as a dead slot (#3508), while `approval-service.ts` now expands a queue to its members (ADR-0142 D6) and only warns when it expands to nobody. Not named by a wave-2 source; reported for the anchor.
